description: This file is a shell script for testing Git file mode merge scenarios, including setting up test environments, executing merges with different strategies, and verifying file permissions and conflict states.

methods.name: do_one_mode
methods.description: Performs a merge with a specified strategy and verifies that 'file1' has the correct mode (executable bit).

methods.name: do_both_modes
methods.description: Performs a merge with a specified strategy on 'file2' with conflicting mode changes and verifies the conflict detection and file mode.

methods.name: do_delete_modechange
methods.description: Tests the conflict scenario where a file is deleted in one branch and has a mode change in another.
